notes: The positive inner branch is exactly the quartic 5(1−x²)², not the parabola 5−2.5x²: it fits every point in E10–E18 (e.g. 4.5919 at 0.1, 2.9625 at 0.5, 0.5037 at 0.9, −0.1308 at 0.99, −0.1931 at 0.999), and at x=1 it gives −0.2, which equals x⁵/2 there, so the branch joins the outer region continuously. The rest (x⁵/2 outside [−1,1], 0 on (−1,0], 0 at 0, −12 at −1) is unchanged.
